body:
Closes #384

Docs-only PR: commits the dual Newton handoff from the issue 380 session and the issue 384 measurement record. **No solver code changes ship; both fix lanes from the handoff are measured dead and the audit numbers are recorded so nobody re-attempts this blind.**

What was done (all probes temporary, reverted before commit, RungAudit pattern):

- Per-callsite counters on `CostateDualSolver.solve` over the sweep and full ProblemsTest quantified the capped population: sweep has 9,551 dual solves, 53% capped at `MAX_ITER = 100`, owning 13.3 of 15.7 in-dual seconds (LRS window CF ladders 8.7 s, free-start jointLadder 5.6 s). ProblemsTest is dominated by B&B node bounds where unconverged duals are valid looser bounds. The sweep contains zero theta chain scans; the 140-theta machine exists only on the farseed/j990 pins.
- Contribution audit: every candidate population is load-bearing. All 11 joint ladder rungs win or improve somewhere, window CF alternates win 10/375 (last) + 25/159 (lead-in), SLP alternates 7/283, the rHi probe already skips the bisection 58% of the time. No call-site deletion or consolidation is corpus-neutral and measurably profitable.
- Lane A (exit heuristics), three independent corpus breakages: the handoff's relative-stall bail loses j717 shift outright (sweep 52-56 s); `MAX_ITER` 25 re-ignites the j716 wrap-close burn (+13 s); `MAX_ITER` 50 is a stable -31% sweep (19 s vs 27.5 s, 104/104) but loses gh283-j990-cold (0/39) in ProblemsTest.
- The decisive experiment: the j990 outcome is deterministic but NON-MONOTONE in the cap (100 solves, 95 fails, 90 solves, 75/60/50 fail; all repeatable). Truncated iterates redraw a downstream trajectory lottery; there is no threshold to tune toward. Capped solves are slow convergence, not waste: their iterates still crawl toward the optimum and downstream consumers use those tail digits.
- Lane B: one clean consolidation found (a margin-0 continuous-infeasibility certificate in `solveWindow`, identical to the one `SlpSolve` already computes, skipping alternates + SLP on 72 provably hopeless windows, ~1,900 solves removed, identical stage winners) but it is wall-neutral because hopeless solves already exit early via `LAMBDA_CAP`. Skipped per the complexity rule, shape documented for any future solveWindow restructure.

The cap50 -31% sweep number stays on the table only as an explicit ruling (it costs the j990 free-start pin, and the non-monotone cliff means any passing cap is overfit to today's corpus). Recommendation in the doc: do not.

Gates on the shipped tree (code-identical to dev 64dada4): `:core:test` green, `:core:check -PslowTests` green, FreeStartSweepBench 104/104 at the machine's current baseline, ProblemsTest 111 OK.
title: docs(research): issue 384 dual Newton iteration audit, both lanes measured dead
